thesis: The speakers discuss the importance of out-of-sample testing to distinguish genuine market features from noise generated by data mining and p-hacking. They argue that historical factor premiums, such as value, persist over long cycles driven by human behavior and remain exploitable even when accounting for transaction costs and limits to arbitrage.
